purpose: Separate early event-formation failures from later preservation failures across three I2V backbones and three physics benchmarks.

protocol.attention_storage: sampled scalar activation statistics only; no attention matrices or latent tensors
protocol.conditioning_policy: One frozen image per case is shared by every model, seed, and arm. Generation prompts are never rewritten per model or arm.
